knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Hourly analysis

```{r hourly, eval=FALSE}

combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(settlement_date = as.Date(interval_start),
         settlement_time = format(as.POSIXct(interval_start),
                                  format="%H:%M"), #format time
         is_hp_installed = as.numeric(installed_at <= interval_start)
  ) %>%
  arrange(interval_start) %>%
  group_by(settlement_time) %>%
  mutate(settlement_period = cur_group_id())  %>%
  select(read_value, settlement_period, is_hp_installed, mpan, settlement_date)

combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  left_join(ev_mpan) %>%
  mutate(has_ev = ifelse(!is.na(ev_start), as.numeric(settlement_date >= ev_start), 0))

gc()

# lighten up the regression by sampling
set.seed(12345)
sample_mpan <- sample(combined_df$mpan %>% unique(), 500)
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  filter(mpan %in% sample_mpan)
gc()

m_hourly <- feols(read_value ~ i(settlement_period, ref=1) +
                    i(settlement_period,is_hp_installed, ref2=0) 
                  | mpan + settlement_date + has_ev,
                  cluster = ~ mpan,
                  data = combined_df)

saveRDS(m_hourly, "../data/scratch/m_hourly.RDS")

# midnight consumption
midnight <- combined_df %>% filter(settlement_period==1, is_hp_installed==0, has_ev==0) %>% summarise(mean_consumption = mean(read_value, na.rm = TRUE))

# Extract coefficients and standard errors
coefs <- coeftable(m_hourly) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  separate(term, into = c("remove", "ubeube", "settlement_period", "has_hp"), sep = ":") %>%
  mutate(settlement_period = as.numeric(settlement_period),
         adjusted_estimate = Estimate + midnight$mean_consumption,
         lower_ci = adjusted_estimate - 1.96 * `Std..Error`,
         upper_ci = adjusted_estimate + 1.96 * `Std..Error`,
         has_hp = ifelse(!is.na(has_hp), "Yes", "No")
  ) 

# Add the row for settlement_period == 1, is_cosy == NA, and Estimate == midnight$mean_consumption
midnight_row <- tibble(
  settlement_period = 1,
  has_hp = "No",
  estimate = midnight$mean_consumption,
  std.error = 0,
  lower_ci = midnight$mean_consumption,
  upper_ci = midnight$mean_consumption,
  cosy = "No",
  adjusted_estimate = midnight$mean_consumption,
  remove = NA
)

# Bind the midnight_row to the coefs dataframe
coefs <- bind_rows(midnight_row, coefs)

# Function to convert settlement period to time
settlement_period_to_time <- function(period) {
  hours <- (period - 1) %/% 2
  minutes <- ifelse((period %% 2) == 1, "00", "30")
  sprintf("%02d:%s", hours, minutes)
}

# Apply the function to create time labels
coefs <- coefs %>%
  mutate(time_label = settlement_period_to_time(settlement_period))

# Select a few representative time labels to display for clarity
selected_periods <- seq(min(coefs$settlement_period), max(coefs$settlement_period), by = 2)
display_labels <- coefs %>%
  filter(settlement_period %in% selected_periods) %>%
  distinct(settlement_period, time_label) %>%
  pull(time_label)

# Ensure breaks and labels have the same length
selected_periods <- coefs %>%
  filter(settlement_period %in% selected_periods) %>%
  distinct(settlement_period) %>%
  pull(settlement_period)

# Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefs, aes(x = settlement_period, y = adjusted_estimate, color = has_hp, group = has_hp)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of HeatPump Installation",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Half Hourly Impact of HP in kWh"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
    legend.position = "bottom"  # Place legend on the right
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = selected_periods,
    labels = display_labels,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))  # Adjust expansion to make space for labels
  )

ggsave("../graphs/hourly_consumption.png", width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
